title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scottish Open Showcases Mixed Field
items.text: The Genesis Scottish Open features seven LIV players including Jon Rahm and Tyrrell Hatton competing alongside PGA Tour stars Scottie Scheffler, Rory McIlroy, and Matt Fitzpatrick in a rare event blending top talents before The Open amid uncertainty over LIV's future after Saudi funding ends this season.

items.headline: Firestone Hosts Final PGA Tour Champions Event
items.text: The Kaulig Companies Championship at Firestone Country Club’s South Course is the last PGA Tour event there after 72 years; from 2027 the Senior Players Championship moves to Newport Beach Country Club in California and will be renamed the Hoag Senior Players Championship.
